notes.title: Final Chapter - part 2 update.
notes.content:
-1 new story chapter.
-2 more combat allies.
-1 new zone.
-1 new combat arena.
-1 new enemy type.
-20 new examine spots.
-1 new song.

Only one chapter left to the final conclusion of the series. Should be a week~ to finish.

notes.title: Final Chapter - part 1 update.
notes.content:
-First part of the finale story.
-1 new zone.
-3 new enemies.
-1 new boss.
-1 new song.
-1 new friendly combat npc.
-multiple bugfixes regarding targeting mishaps.
-bugfix regarding incorrect sprite drawn in combat scenes.

notes.title: Patch 1.021
notes.content:
-Target assist turned off for now while I add it as an option.
-Parrying and certain actions would turn current target into your attack's target, this should never happen, if any other such behaviour happens please report it. Attack's targets should only ever change if the enemy dies before the attack can land.
-Fixed the train section's battle arenas not appearing and defaulting to the test arena.
-Fixed door and transition issues in the sunken zone.
-Enemies added to the sunken zone.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
-1 new boss-fight.
-1 new summon.
-1 new achievement.
-4 new enemy arenas. The enemies for them will be added in the next patch alongside the 3 new enemies.
-Bugs fixed regarding the bosses sprites displaying incorrectly.

notes.title: 1.011 Patch
notes.content:
-Bugfix regarding statue enemy
-Typo fixes
-Final boss/summon animated, will be made avilable to play next patch.

Final act will be added area by area.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
-1 new boss.
-1 new song.
-1 new summon.
-1 new achievement.
-bugfixes regarding summon fight trigger corpses.
-bugfixes regarding inventory for new items.
-bugfix regarding the infinite loop train rooms when attempting to go backwards.

The final optional summon should be added in the next patch.

notes.title: 1.0 Patch
notes.content:
-New ambiance and music added for certain areas.
-Certain areas are now available for combat.
-Howard conversations added.
-Gui changes for more clarity.
-Overall bugfixes.
-12 Steam achivements added.

notes.title: #Patch 20
notes.content:
-The two new optional areas are now open. Find the Train ticket where you fight the crustacian boss. Take the ride, and explore. 
-For now the new areas have no unique music, lack some vfx, and all enemies are removed.
-42 more examine spots, for old and the new areas.

Once these areas are finished and their bosses are placed. All otpional areas are done, and I am moving on to the final section of the game. The end of the story, and the entire series.

notes.title: #Patch 19
notes.content:
-147 examine spots adde to the game. 
Enjoy reading.

notes.title: #Patch 18
notes.content:
-Fixed multiple crash causing bugs regarding the new enemies.
-Fixed crash causing bug regarding the camera control, prevention implemented.
-Hunter boss, and its system is now finished and active.
-Overworld enemy depth miss-match fixed.

notes.title: #Patch 17
notes.content:
-27 new rooms added, most of them are locked for now until the two new optional areas are finished.
-Bug with new mobs getting stuck in combat now fixed.
-New key items for the optional areas added.
-Assets for 3 new enemies finished and added in. Not on the spawn list yet.

Hopefully the next update will finally finish the hunter boss, and make it available along with the new areas.

notes.title: #Patch 16
notes.content:
-5 new enemies added.
-Multiple mob encounters now have a chance to occur from the start.
-Spawn tables changed for two major areas.

notes.title: #Patch 15
notes.content:
-Alphonse scene teleport shenanigans now have a visual effect alongside them to fit.
-The first summon is now active and useable, acquired after beating the library boss. Costs 1 Yth stone to summon in a fight.
-Yth stone drop rates raised across the board to enable summoning.
-Summons will scale off Eld, baseline code for this is enabled, the npc to do so will be added soon.

notes.title: #Patch 14
notes.content:
-Steam screenshots enabled. 
-Library is now combat enabled, enemies are added to match the change.
-New boss added at the end of the Library. 
-New song added for the new boss.
-New item, the first summon added. However summoning is not active yet as the system needs more added before it can be activated. It still cost Yth stones if you try to summon it right now so don't bother yet.

notes.title: #Patch 13
notes.content:
-Doors are not marked with a circle, will make a different way of marking them, but for now it works.
-Default movement speed increased, enemy movement speed raised to match it.
-Run speed adjusted to match the increase.
-New room added to connect b3 left and right. Should make it harder to forget about it and thus miss a boss.

notes.title: #Patch 12
notes.content:
-Movement code fully revised again from the ground up for gamepad's sake. Should be fine now while keeping wall sliding, and no inter-cardinal speed boosting.
-Menu inputs for gamepads fully reworked.
-New area is now locked by the new key item acquired after a certain bossfight.
-Luck coin exp and vitae bonus is now fully functional, it DOES stack with overkill bonuses.

notes.title: #Patch 11
notes.content:
-8 new rooms in the new optional area. 
-1 new song for the area.

The new area is empty for now untill the boss is finished.

notes.title: #Patch 10
notes.content:
-Wrong defensive action punishment severely reduced from 2x dmg to 20% extra dmg. 
-Wrong defensive action now displays a message noting that the player used the incorrect defence.
-Enemy attack timers now have text above them prompting the player to defend.
-Consumables descriptions changed, % chances removed.
-Both offensive QTES  moved to centre of the screen for better notice-ability, and eye movement.
-Combat manual updated.
-Splash screen changed.

notes.title: #Patch 9
notes.content:
-25 item pickups added to the world, all of which are expensive consumables.
-The second handmade map was added to the game.
-Corpses will now litter appropriate areas, also hinting at the presence of the hunter miniboss.

notes.title: #Patch 8
notes.content:
-7 New consumeable items added.
-The shop for these items is now open and functional in the Hub.
-Haste item added.
-Healing injection added.
-Fury potion added.
-Suicide pill added.
-Combo Chainlink added.
-Grd regen potion added.
-Luck potion added.
-Overkills now actually generate double rewards.

notes.title: #Patch 7
notes.content:
-Inventory now loops.
-Certain music volumes lowered.
-Combo menu issues on keyboard fixed.
-Timing qte adjusted for visual delay.
-Respawning in the same room now properly deducts your vitae and exp.
-Running from combat now removes the overworld enemy's alert state, letting you actually escape from the encounter.
-Text log double registering the current line is now fixed.
-New combat action added to items, a free non-consumable, "wait and focus" command, restores 10% of your max GRD.
-Movement code redone, no more inter-cardinal sonic the hedgehog movement...

notes.title: #Patch 6
notes.content:
-Full gamepad support. Some menus still require analog stick support, namely main menu/settings/levelup, these menus can only be used with d-pad for now.
However combat fully supports analog sticks.
-Full input rework for the whole game to accommodate gamepads at a base level.
-Gamepad rebinds will be added later.

notes.title: #Patch 5
notes.content:
-Status times no longer stack, only reapply at the described length, with the exception of doom.
-Intercardinal menu inputs improved, still needs some casework.
-Ground floor map added, more to come, each with unique art and placement.

notes.title: #Patch 4
notes.content:
-Level up pedestal bugs fixes, and clarification added for confirmation of spending a point. 
-Font fixes to eliminate jittering numbers.
-Cast, and Execution phase timeline icon will now display the current attack even on targeted enemies.
-Tab targeting issues fixed.
-6 more combat songs added.

notes.title: #Patch 3
notes.content:
-Bugs regarding adds surviving their bosses, fixed.
-Keyboard rebinds added, if you notice any inconsistencies please post about it. 
Gamepad support will be finished tomorrow.

notes.title: #Patch 2
notes.content:
-You can now only use defensive actions during the enemy's attack phase. 
-You can now attack in the overworld, enemies hit by this are disabled for a time, touching them starts combat in your favour, reducing their current Guard by 20%, and lets you make the first move.
-Running in the overworld now has a Guard cost.
-Escaping an encounter reduces your Guard to Zero.

notes.title: #Patch 1
notes.content:
Day 1 patches contained the following changes:

-Guard regen outside of combat endabled. Next will be running cost deduction.
-720p, and 900p resolutions and fullscreen on/off added to settings. Next will be full key rebinds.
-Treasure chest added for all weapons/spells instead of generic on ground item icon.
-Overworld enemy alert, and chase system added. For now they work on a simple line of sight, when broken they stop, this is normal for now.
-Darkness and light values inside Manor adjusted for a less "staring into the sun" experience.
